description: HOTOSM Heard Island and McDonald Islands Airports (OpenStreetMap Export) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: aeroway IS NOT NULL OR building = 'aerodrome' OR emergency:helipad IS NOT NULL OR emergency = 'landingsite' Features may have these attributes: - emergency:helipad - emergency - building - capacity:persons - addr:full - operator:type - addr:city - aeroway ... Coverage: Heard Island and McDonald Islands. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are aviation, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, transportation. It offers 8 resource(s) in GARMIN IMG, GEOPACKAGE, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
